newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $73 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $73 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area early Wednesday, turning slow again after noon, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 31,200 slaughter steers and 22,100 heifers; 86,100 head confirmed for week to date which includes 15,600 formulated and 800 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 73.00.
Confirmed - 53,300 Week Ago - None Year Ago - 18,500
Wk to date - 86,100 Week Ago - 14,300 Year Ago - 48,900
